component.name: Cuebot
component.summary: Streaming automation with actions, triggers, Twitch, OBS and text-to-speech

description.p: Cuebot reacts to stream events (chat commands, follows, cheers, raids, OBS scene changes, timers) by running actions you build in a list or node-graph editor. Actions can talk in chat, control OBS, speak text aloud and run your own C# or Python code.
